metaDescription: Order custom flame resistant shirts for your team. Perfect Imprints offers bulk pricing and quality decoration. Get a quote today.
introHtml: Flame resistant shirts are essential for industries where workers face thermal hazards like arc flash or flash fire. Unlike standard workwear, these shirts are engineered with FR-rated fabrics that self-extinguish, reducing burn injury severity. For safety managers and business owners, custom flame resistant shirts combine OSHA-compliant protection with your company logo, ensuring your team stays safe while reinforcing brand identity on-site. Choose from durable cotton blends or lightweight materials with options for embroidery or screen printing.
heroAltText: Custom flame resistant shirts with logo embroidery, featuring durable FR fabric and safety compliance for industrial workwear.
